Zero-dependency .NET charting library. permalink: /chart/types/area/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Daily Active Users") .Size(700, 420) .XAxis("Day", "Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun") .YAxis("Users", min: 0) .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddArea("Active Users", new double[] { 4200, 5100, 4800, 6300, 7200, 3800, 2900 }, cfg => cfg.Color(ChartColor.ChartBlue).FillOpacity(0.3))) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
